primitives.name: Transition Evidence Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Transition evidence Each transition requires: - typed actor; - reason; - current policy version; - evidence with a valid SHA-256 digest; - audit receipt; - owner approval and a scoped, unexpired, single-use token when policy requires it.
primitives.assumptions: Each transition must be uniquely identified by typed actor, reason, and policy version; evidence integrity verified via SHA-256; owner approval requires scoped token.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs on mismatched policy version or invalid digest.

layer2.mapping: Evidence kernel maps to GSI's probabilistic state update function, where each transition is a Bayesian evidence event.
layer2.telemetry: SHA-256 digest validation and token expiration status.

primitives.name: Atomic Transition Log
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Insert transition/effect/receipt records atomically where the contract requires them.
primitives.assumptions: All transition records must be inserted atomically to maintain consistency across state machines.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs on partial insertion or concurrent modification.

layer2.mapping: Log kernel underpins GSE's deterministic state evolution engine, ensuring atomicity of effect propagation.
layer2.telemetry: Transaction commit success/failure and effect consistency check.

primitives.name: Versioned Policy Update Predicate
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Match `expectedVersion`; update with the version predicate; increment once.
primitives.assumptions: Policy updates are strictly ordered by version number; mismatch triggers rollback or retry.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs on version mismatch or non-monotonic increment.

layer2.mapping: Version predicate mirrors GSI's policy belief revision logic, enforcing temporal consistency.
layer2.telemetry: Version number match and monotonic increment verification.
